review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the complete generator, browser JavaScript, CSS, grader, solver, controls.json, env.json, task.json and verifier. Shared exported-result loading was read previously in full.
decision: Keep all four baseline labels and no supported configuration exceptions. The task is a static oriented-volume fit plus cross-view correspondence problem. A synchronized frame is a selectable static plate of the same objects, not evidence of movement. The calibrated overhead, front and side images are simultaneously displayed alongside the colored scan; optional view aids and known target/frame selectors do not by themselves require an exploration label.

rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: No prerequisite hidden rule or missing camera plate must be discovered: the three calibrated projections and scan are visible, and the controls state how to edit and link. Optional orbit/pan/zoom is not sufficient evidence that an active information-revealing probe is necessary.
rationale_clarifications.reasoning_planning: Center, half-extents, yaw and cross-view correspondences must agree. Lower profiles still enforce a 3D intersection-over-union threshold of 0.62 in addition to center, extent and yaw tolerances; broad individual tolerances alone do not establish that the starting cuboids already solve the fitting problem.

uncertainties: Source-based capability judgments; no screenshot-only gameplay or empirical validation of profile boundaries.
